newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dollar edges closer to 124 yen in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Dollar edges closer to 124 yen in Tokyo.

text.p: 0545 GMT --*Dollar edged higher vs yen in mid-afternoon Tokyo, buoyed by buying of mark and sterling for yen in cross trading.
*Stop-loss buying triggered at 123.80 yen, which pushed dollar higher, dealers said.
*Further rises to 124 yen possible, although profit-taking may emerge to limit dollar's gains.
*A trust bank dealer said sudden rise possible in thin market if investers join market with large bids.
*Although the way has been cleared for further gains by early morning long liquidation, offers near 123.70 yen and wariness about trying topside may limit upward moves.

*Rises against yen in cross-trading also appear to be stalled, with mark falling back below 75 yen in face of offers above that level while pound clung near 203 yen. "It will be extremely difficult for the dollar/yen to rise on its own without a boost from the crosses," another dealer said.
